changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0020. Workout programs are plans. Workout sessions are performed work. System programs have a null tenant. User programs store UserId and TenantId. Sets keep optional weight, reps, duration, and distance so strength and cardio share one table. Index review: unique day number and exercise sequence; IX_WorkoutSessions_User_Started for history; IX_WorkoutPrograms_Tenant for the program list. Child tables are reached from the parent key, so they do not repeat UserId. Performance note: history and personal-record queries start at the user session index and then join exercises and sets.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.WorkoutSets; DROP TABLE app.WorkoutSessionExercises; DROP TABLE app.WorkoutSessions; DROP TABLE app.WorkoutProgramExercises; DROP TABLE app.WorkoutProgramDays; DROP TABLE app.WorkoutPrograms;
